Safari image-loading overrides for MediaFigure: a
Source core/safari/patches/media-figure/image-load.ts
UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

safariLoadHighRes

Safari loadHighRes: requests the Q50 (medium) variant instead of the uncompressed source — iOS Safari hard-fails canvas/decode on images above ~4096px and the Q100 asset frequently exceeds texture memory.

bindSafariImageLoad

Lazy-thumbnail + img-observer wiring for non-hero images: the thumb defers via loading=lazy and the Q50 swap triggers once the figure scrolls within ROOT_MARGIN_50 of the viewport.
